A skintight [[Color/Legends|black]] '''combat suit''' was owned by the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]. The suit was equipped with high [[Boot/Legends|boots]], a [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] belt, knee pads, and detachable sleeves.<ref name="Allegiance" />
